findings.problem: API and benchmark with different data_dir could execute models on the same GPU concurrently.
findings.change: Shared HARNESS_LOCK_DIR admission lease; API and offline CLI use same Compose writable volume.

findings.problem: Parent-only lease disappeared after scheduler hard-kill while model child could still be running.
findings.change: Spawned wrapper owns compute lease until its process exits; new scheduler cannot enter computation while orphan remains.

findings.problem: Docker could be healthy from liveness alone while models/readiness failed.
findings.change: Authenticated bounded readiness probe requires ready=true and fixture=false.

findings.problem: Process.start failure could leak admission lease and IPC; invalid per-call override could disable hard deadline.
findings.change: Bounded bootstrap, finite positive per-call validation, startup cleanup, callback-failure worker cleanup.

findings.problem: Source ZIP omitted reviewed runtime config example and lacked clean-clone CI.
findings.change: Allowlisted examples/docs/workflows plus pinned official Actions CI for Ubuntu contracts and explicit manual Docker build/import smoke.

findings.problem: Docker layers/build and GPU generations have not executed in this Windows environment.
findings.required_evidence: Actual CI Docker build/import run plus target doctor/API/model/GPU benchmark reports for exact commit/image.
findings.not_claimed: No actual Docker build, GPU correctness, VRAM, latency or OCR quality pass.

findings.problem: Top-level versions and base image digest are pinned, but full transitive Linux wheel/hash lock is not yet frozen.
findings.required_evidence: Resolve/build on Linux, retain installed build.freeze and then reviewed hashes or final immutable image artifact.
findings.not_claimed: Metadata availability and Windows pip check do not prove Linux dependency resolution.

dependency_probe_note: pip cross-platform metadata request found exact Linux top-level wheels, then failed on Windows-only pywin32 marker: pip --platform does not override the host marker environment; this is not evidence of a Linux package conflict.
